start: Admin app, Messages & offers, Offers, no running offer

steps.action: Under 'Start a workout offer' set 10 workouts in 30 days, 3 days reward, last day to join, giving by hand; save
user_sees: The offer listed as open with joined 0, in now 0, ready 0, given 0
must_not: Two running offers at once
The offer starting on another day than today

user_sees: The member shown as 'Ready for reward'
must_not: The member shown ready with fewer than 10 matched days

user_sees: The member's plan last day moved 3 days later; plan shows 'Extended free by 3 days (reward)'
must_not: A receipt or GST made for the reward
The days added twice

start: Admin app, Offers, starting an offer that gives the days by themselves

steps.action: Pick 'Give the days by themselves' and start the offer
user_sees: The words 'When a member reaches the target, the days are added to their plan at once. You see it in the list and on their page, and you can take it back.'
must_not: The offer saved with giving by hand

user_sees: The member listed as given, given by 'Automatic'
must_not: The member left as 'Ready for reward' while a plan is running

start: Admin app, Offers, one offer already running

user_sees: A refusal that one offer is already running
must_not: A second running offer saved

steps.action: Start with 40 workouts, or 12 workouts in 7 days, or a last day to join 100 days away
must_not: The offer saved with numbers outside 4-30 workouts, 7-60 days, 1-7 reward days

start: Admin app, Offers, a running offer with a member already given 3 days

user_sees: Question 'Take back the 3 reward days from <name>? Their plan's last day goes back.'
The plan's last day back by 3 days and a line 'Reward taken back' in its notes
must_not: The plan's last day moved back after the plan was renewed or changed since the reward

steps.action: Tap Give again on the same member
must_not: The front desk able to give it again

user_sees: Question 'Stop this offer? Nobody new can join. Members already in keep their days to finish.'
must_not: Members already in losing their window or their reward

start: Admin app, Offers list with five members in the offer

user_sees: Each member with counted days, desk and app days side by side, and the reward state
must_not: A member's mobile number, exercises, weights or workout length
Members of another gym

start: Admin app, front desk signed in, Offers list shows a member 'Ready for reward'

user_sees: The member listed as given, given by the desk person's name; the plan's last day 3 days later
must_not: The days added to a PT pack or a cancelled plan
Days other than the offer's reward days

start: Admin app, front desk signed in, Offers

steps.action: Try to start, change or stop an offer, or take a reward back
user_sees: A refusal that only the owner can
must_not: The offer changed by the front desk

steps.action: Tap Give on a member whose reward the owner took back
user_sees: A refusal that the reward was taken back
must_not: The days given again by the desk

steps.action: Tap Give on a member with no running gym plan
user_sees: A refusal that there is no plan to add the days to
must_not: The days lost or marked given with no plan changed

start: Admin app, two desk phones, the same member 'Ready for reward'

steps.action: Both tap Give within a second
user_sees: One give; the second phone told it was already given
must_not: 6 days added
Two notes lines

start: Admin app, front desk signed in, Offers list

steps.action: Open the list of members in the offer
user_sees: Counts of days and the reward state only
must_not: Mobile numbers, exercises or body weight
